## Local Development

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+
- Git

### Setup

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Gajabgamer/attain-your-focus.git
cd attain-your-focus

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Run development server
npm run dev
```

### Database Setup

```bash
# Apply database migrations
npm run db:migrate:local

# Push schema changes
npm run db:push
```

---

## Environment Variables

Configure the following environment variables in your `.env.local` file:

| Variable | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Primary database connection URL |
| `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` | Authentication secret key |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` | GitHub OAuth app client ID |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` | GitHub OAuth app client secret |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | Groq API key for AI reasoning |
